summaries.Romania: Romania faces a deepening energy crisis as the Turceni coal plant shuts down unexpectedly during peak demand, while foreign investment plummets 82% signaling lost competitiveness. The government navigates conflicting pressures on public sector salaries and EU compliance with only weeks left on critical PNRR deadlines.
summaries.Healthcare: A personalized mRNA cancer vaccine from Moderna and Merck showed promising Phase 3 results in melanoma, while healthcare AI adoption accelerates with chatbots querying patient records and predictive tools expanding into prior authorization workflows. Meanwhile, Romania remains Europe's laggard on accessing innovative medicines, with patients waiting twice as long as the EU average.
summaries.Tech: Apple's September event looms with 10+ new products leaked including camera-equipped AirPods (delayed to 2027), foldable iPhone, and HomePad; meanwhile AI competition intensifies as OpenAI slows development for security while Stripe acquires OpenRouter and Amazon aggressively expands drone delivery to 500 US cities.
